text:
ANTIFRAUD::device_id
Description
This iRules command returns device id generated by bigip.
Syntax
ANTIFRAUD
::
device_id
Examples
when
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
{
log
local0.
"device id: [ANTIFRAUD::device_id]."
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANTIFRAUD_ALERT
Introduced: BIGIP-15.0.0
